notes.title: PWCT 2.0 (Source Code - MIT License) for Windows/Linux/macOS
notes.content:
Hello

The source code for PWCT 2.0 was released on 2025.01.03

Running PWCT 2.0 from Source Code (Windows/Linux/macOS)

1. Install the Ring programming language

2. Get a copy from the source code using Git

git clone https://github.com/pwct/pwct2


3. Run the main source file

cd pwct2

ring pwct.ring 

Thanks!

notes.title: Update Notes For April 15
notes.content:
Hello

(1) In this update we added PWCT Videos to the Help menu

To open a video
1 - From the Menu bar click (Help)
2 - Select PWCT Videos (Introduction to Programming)
3 - Click on the lesson title 

(2) Also, We added the samples created in the videos (From lesson 1 to lesson 27)

To open these samples
1 - Run PWCT 2.0
2 - Click (Project Files)
3 - Select (FromPWCTVideos) folder

More educational resources (Videos/Samples/Tutorials/etc.) are coming in the future!

Thanks!

notes.title: PWCT 2.0 Rev. 2023.03.09
notes.content:

To open these samples and games
